GRIEVANCE XVII ◆ THE WORLD BEYOND

He has made the pledges of common defense appear conditional, withdrawing reassurance from exposed allies.

THE RECORD SHOWS

U.S. troop reductions in Germany and the Baltic region, coupled with presidential threats and limited consultation, have unsettled NATO partners.

Reuters documented troop withdrawals and European alarm. U.S. officials argue that Europe should shoulder more defense responsibility; NATO leaders have also publicly emphasized continuing alliance commitments. The grievance concerns erosion of confidence, not a claim that the United States formally left NATO.

A DOCUMENTED SEQUENCE

3 MILESTONES
  1. February 2026European leaders publicly questioned whether the transatlantic alliance still shared a common understanding of collective defense.
  2. May 2026Reported U.S. troop reductions in Germany renewed NATO concern about Washington’s commitment.
  3. July 2026Additional quiet U.S. pullbacks in Eastern Europe amplified anxiety among countries nearest Russia.

WHAT THE RECORD DOES NOT ESTABLISH

Alliance burden-sharing is a legitimate policy dispute. The complaint is about uncertainty, abrupt unilateral changes, and the strategic effect on exposed European allies.
